title: Inheritance and Method Overriding knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly distinguishes TypeScript access modifiers and JavaScript private fields?
options: JavaScript #private fields are comments removed before execution.
TypeScript private is primarily a type-checking restriction; JavaScript #private fields enforce runtime privacy.
Both mechanisms are identical in all runtime behavior.
questions.answer_key: TypeScript private is primarily a type-checking restriction; JavaScript #private fields enforce runtime privacy.
questions.explanation: Runtime behavior matters when selecting an encapsulation mechanism.

questions.prompt: Which statement is correct about “Inheritance and Method Overriding”?
options: The learner should publish hidden solutions so the exercise can grade itself.
The concept should be demonstrated with extends and checked against its intended contract.
The safest approach is to skip diagnostics and trust the first output.
A type assertion automatically validates every value at runtime.
questions.answer_key: The concept should be demonstrated with extends and checked against its intended contract.
questions.explanation: The supplied syllabus explicitly includes “extends”; connect it to a concrete example and verify the behavior relevant to this lesson.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “Inheritance and Method Overriding”?
options: Check super, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
Assume overridden methods and compatible signatures is unnecessary because the code has type annotations.
Ignore compiler or test failures if the interface looks correct.
Treat passing a static token check as proof that the program executed correctly.
questions.answer_key: Check super, include a meaningful failure case where appropriate, and document any runtime or version assumptions.
questions.explanation: The syllabus includes “super”. Verification should match the concept: type-level checks, runtime tests, configuration checks or human review as appropriate.
